results.name: stream-engine-kill
notes: windows published during the outage were processed from the Kinesis checkpoint on restart

results.name: broker-outage
notes: run 1 FAILED (25% of outage-period windows, 24 sequence gaps): the local IoT-rule emulator had a clean MQTT session on a non-persistent broker, so messages published before it resubscribed were dropped. Fixed by broker persistence + a persistent session for the emulator (as an IoT rule is always subscribed). Re-run: every device, zero gaps. The completeness ratio >1 reflects a pre-fault baseline window that included the broker restart; gaps and device coverage are the criteria.

results.name: agent-down
notes: the SOS was paged by the rules path while the agent service was stopped; the brief followed once it restarted and drained its queue (SQS retains the events)

results.name: alert-service-kill
notes: the escalation timer came due while the service was down; it fired from Postgres on restart and paged
